devicesMFE.py.summary: DevicesMFE is a test automation page class for the HPX Devices MFE (Micro Frontend) interface. It extends HPXFlow and provides comprehensive verification and action flows for device management UI testing. The class implements patterns for verifying UI elements (navigation, device cards, icons, buttons), managing device interactions (printers, pens, dock stations), and handling user authentication flows. It includes Windows-specific dummy printer handling for testing scenarios where actual printer addition is not possible. The class uses Selenium WebDriver for browser automation and includes screenshot comparison decorators for visual regression testing. Key features include device card management, profile/settings navigation, window state management (maximize/minimize/restore), and HP AI assistant interactions.
